jobs.title: Tax Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Tax Training Specialist**  

Do you want a career without limits? Do you want to shape your own future and be surrounded by people who listen? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you at Smith \+ Howard.  

  

Smith \+ Howard is a family of companies that offers tax, audit, accounting and advisory and wealth management services. We are headquartered in Atlanta with offices across the Southeast, while still offering a local firm flavor.  

  

We offer competitive pay, excellent training opportunities, and great benefits. You can help influence our culture and have the support and dedication from our leaders to help you achieve your career goals. Smith \+ Howard provides a great opportunity for professional growth and advancement within one of Atlanta’s top companies.  

  

If you are ready to make a career move and join a firm consistently named an “AJC Top Workplace” and a “Best of the Best Firms” (Inside Public Accounting), we invite you to complete our employment application.  

  

**Summary**  

This is a blended role that will shift in focus throughout the year based on business needs. During busy season, this individual will perform billable client work similar to our Tax Seniors, supporting client engagements and contributing to the team’s workload. During the non\-busy season, the focus will shift toward training, onboarding, and developing team members, along with other internal initiatives and process improvements.  

  

**Essential Functions*** **Training Design \& Delivery**
	+ Assist in the planning, coordination, and delivery of tax training programs for new hires, experienced staff, and acquisition team members.
	+ Facilitate and support virtual and in\-person training sessions, workshops, and learning events.
	+ Serve as a resource for employees seeking training information, guidance, and learning resources.
* **New Hire \& Acquisition Integration**
	+ Help develop and maintain onboarding materials, learning plans, and training schedules.
	+ Monitor onboarding progress and provide support to employees throughout their transition and learning journey.
	+ Assist with the coordination and delivery of orientation and training activities to ensure a successful onboarding experience.
* **Curriculum Development**
	+ Collaborate with the Manager of Tax Training \& Education, subject matter experts, and department leaders to develop and enhance training materials.
	+ Ensure training content remains accurate, current, and consistent with firm processes, policies, and best practices.
	+ Help identify opportunities for new training content based on employee feedback, industry changes, and business needs.
* **Program Management \& Evaluation**
	+ Assist with the management of the annual tax training calendar and with the evaluation of training effectiveness through assessments, surveys, and feedback; use results to improve future sessions.
	+ Support compliance with CPE requirements, including attendance tracking, documentation, and reporting requirements.
	+ Prepare communications related to training programs, educational opportunities, deadlines, and learning resources.
* **Technology \& Tools**
	+ Assist in maintaining training platforms, learning management systems, and training resource libraries.
	+ Partner with the Manager of Tax Training \& Education to evaluate and implement tools that enhance the learning experience and training effectiveness.

**Position Requirements*** Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Tax, Education, or related field required.
* CPA preferred.
* 4\+ years of experience in a public accounting firm, with strong exposure to tax compliance and planning.
* Prior experience in training, instructional design, or staff development is highly preferred.
* Strong knowledge of tax laws and regulations affecting individuals, corporations, and partnerships.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and tax preparation software (e.g., Sure prep, Tax Buddy, etc.)
* Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS) and e\-learning authoring tools a plus.

**Competencies*** Ability to simplify complex tax topics for diverse learner groups.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Adaptability and sensitivity in working with acquired teams during periods of transition.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

**Why Join Us:**  

This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the development and success of our professionals. You'll play a key role in shaping the future of tax training in a collaborative, growth\-focused environment that values knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and excellence in client service.

jobs.title: Clinical Services: Product Training Specialist
jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Clinical Services:** **Product Training Specialist** to support customers in learning and successfully using our imaging and skin analysis solutions, with a primary focus on the VISIA® CRP platform. This role is responsible for customer onboarding, equipment training, product demonstrations, and ongoing user education to help customers maximize the value of their investment. The ideal candidate enjoys working directly with customers, teaching new technologies, and building confidence in users through effective training and support. This individual will play an important role in delivering a positive customer experience throughout the customer journey.


**Job Description:**


* Conduct product demonstrations for prospective and existing customers both in an individual and group setting
* Deliver onboarding and training programs for VISIA® CRP systems
* Educate customers on equipment setup, operation, maintenance, and best practices as well as train users on image capture techniques and software workflows
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to help customers maximize system utilization including assisting customers with routine hardware, software, and workflow questions
* Support customer installations, software upgrades, and training sessions both remotely and on\-site
* Create and maintain training materials, reference guides, and educational resources while staying current on product updates, enhancements, and training requirements
* Gather customer feedback and share insights with internal teams
* Support trade shows, conferences, and customer events as needed

**Core Requirements:**


* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
* 1\-3 years of experience in customer training, technical support, product support, healthcare technology, or a related customer\-facing role
* Strong presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills
* Ability to explain technical concepts in a clear and easy\-to\-understand manner
* Proficiency with Microsoft office applications
* Willingness to travel (about 10\-15%) to customer sites, conferences, and training events

**Desired:**


* Experience training users on software, equipment, or technology products, photography, imaging equipment, or image\-based software applications
* Basic understanding of computer hardware and software troubleshooting
* Experience working directly with customers in a support, education, or training role

Canfield Scientific, Inc. is a core imaging lab providing custom photographic systems, image monitoring, and centralized analysis services for the pharmaceutical, biotechnology and cosmetics industries supporting global clinical trials providing primary endpoint data and supporting documentation. Canfield offers comprehensive benefits to its eligible full\-time employees. These include paid days off, medical, dental, and vision insurance, may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, and a 401(k) plan with employer match (currently set at 50%). The anticipated salary range for the position is $65,000\.00\-$90,000\.00 This is dependent upon consideration of multiple factors when determining a base salary such as a candidate’s experience, education, and current market conditions. If the role is eligible for full benefits, it will be discussed with you during the interview process. Canfield's imaging equipment leads the industry providing high\-quality, registered, reproducible clinical images. This, together with proactive clinical image monitoring and a world class quality assurance regimen, sets the gold standard in image quality for clinical studies.


### **Apply Here**

Please submit resumes with cover letter to **jobs@canfieldsci.com** . Please include the position title in the subject line.


We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: NetSuite Implementation Lead
jobs.description:
**About ProvenScale**

ProvenScale is an Oracle NetSuite Alliance Partner delivering NetSuite implementations, functional consulting, and managed services to mid\-market and high growth companies. We work with finance teams at media groups, SaaS companies, retail companies, manufacturers, logistics companies, healthcare platforms, consumer brands, and professional services firms, taking them from legacy systems to a clean NetSuite close.

We are remote first and we are growing fast. This role exists because our senior team needs a peer who can carry projects end to end without supervision.

**The Role**

You will own delivery end\-to\-end.

You will be handed new clients and new implementations and be expected to run them: scope validation, configuration, client relationship, project economics, go\-live, and support through first close. You will be the person the CFO on the other side of the table trusts, and the person we stop worrying about.

This is a hands\-on role. You will be in the system. You will also be the one deciding how the engagement runs.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead full lifecycle NetSuite implementations from kickoff through go\-live and first month\-end close
* Own the client relationship at the CFO and Controller level, including expectation setting, escalations, and scope conversations
* Translate accounting requirements into NetSuite configuration across GL, AP, AR, revenue, consolidation, fixed assets, and reporting
* Configure and validate directly in NetSuite rather than handing everything to a technical resource
* Manage project scope, budget, and timeline against fixed fee SOWs, and raise change orders when scope moves
* Run requirements sessions, configuration walkthroughs, UAT, data migration cycles, training, and cutover
* Mentor consultants and raise the delivery standard across the practice
* Contribute to scoping and estimation on new opportunities alongside our sales team
* Help build the implementation playbooks, templates, and methodology that let us scale

**What We Are Looking For**

* CPA, active or inactive
* Significant accounting leadership experience, ideally as a Controller or Accounting Manager who owned the close
* 4 or more years of hands\-on NetSuite consulting or implementation experience with a partner, VAR, or internal PMO
* Multiple full lifecycle NetSuite implementations delivered as the lead
* Strong functional depth across NetSuite financials. OneWorld, SuiteBilling, ARM, or Fixed Assets experience is a plus
* Comfort owning a client relationship without an account manager in the middle
* Excellent written communication. Our SOWs, status updates, and client documentation are precise for a reason
* Based in the US and able to work core Eastern Time hours

**Nice to Have**

* Experience at a NetSuite Alliance Partner or Solution Provider
* Industry depth in SaaS, media, healthcare, manufacturing, distribution, or professional services
* Experience with integrations, data migration tooling, or AI assisted delivery methods
* Prior experience scaling a consulting practice

**Why ProvenScale**

* Remote first
* Real ownership. You will not be managed through a checklist
* Growing practice with room to shape how implementations run as we scale
* Direct access to leadership and to the decisions that affect your projects
* Benefits: 10% bonus plus discretionary, year\-end profit sharing; health, dental, vision, 401k, unlimited PTO, CPE and certification support.

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume. Tell us about one implementation you led end to end, what nearly went wrong, and what you did about it.

ProvenScale is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Pay: $135,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

Paylocity is an award\-winning provider of cloud\-based HR and payroll software solutions, offering the most complete platform for the modern workforce. The company has become one of the fastest\-growing HCM software providers worldwide by offering an intuitive, easy\-to\-use product suite that helps businesses automate and streamline HR and payroll processes, attract and retain talent, and build a strong workplace culture.


While traditional HR and payroll providers automate basic HR processes such as payroll and benefits administration, Paylocity goes further by developing tools that HR and businesses need to compete for talent and deliver against the expectations of the modern workforce.


We give our employees what they need to succeed, including great benefits and perks! We offer medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and a 401(k) match, as well as perks that support you, your family, and your finances. And if it’s career development you desire, we provide that, too! At Paylocity, people matter most and have always been at the heart of our business.


Help our award\-winning technology company run effectively as you take on big challenges and find solutions with a position in Operations.


Use your problem\-solving skills to shape the way others see Paylocity. Launch your career with us!

**In\-Office:** This is a 100% in\-office role based at our Rochester, NY location. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this position. Candidates must be able to work on\-site five days per week during designated work hours.

**Position Overview**


This role is responsible for supporting client implementations with a strong focus on data migration, validation, and test payroll execution. This role involves collaborating closely with Sales, Data Conversion, Implementation, and Managed Services teams to ensure successful project outcomes and identify opportunities for additional services. The consultant plays a key role in onboarding client data, driving projects to completion, and ensuring go\-live dates are met.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Collaborate internally with Sales, Implementation, and Managed Services teams to ensure successful project outcomes
* Drive projects to completion, ensuring go\-live dates are met
* Play a key role in onboarding client data during the implementation process
* Proactively overcoming challenges

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience
* 1\+ years of Payroll experience required
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data manipulation, and analysis
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize tasks effectively
* Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification is a plus
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment
* Demonstrate organizational and time management abilities
* Excellent decision\-making, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* A solid understanding of payroll compliance at the federal, state, and local levels
* Ability to communicate clearly with clients and provide excellent customer service

**Physical requirements**

* Ability to sit for extended periods: The role requires sitting at a desk or workstation for long periods, typically 7\-8 hours a day.
* Use of computer and phone systems: The employee must be able to operate a computer, use phone systems, and type. This includes using multiple software programs and inquiries simultaneously

jobs.title: RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist - Temporary
jobs.description:
**Let’s do great things, together!**


**About Moda**  

Founded in Oregon in 1955, Moda is proud to be a company of real people committed to quality. Today, like then, we’re focused on building a better future for healthcare. That starts by offering outstanding coverage to our members, compassionate support to our community and comprehensive benefits to our employees. It keeps going by connecting with neighbors to create healthy spaces and places, together. Moda values diversity and inclusion in our workplace. We aim to demonstrate our commitment to diversity through all our business practices and invite applications from candidates that share our commitment to this diversity. Our diverse experiences and perspectives help us become a stronger organization. Let’s be better together.

  

**Position Summary**



The RHTP Primary Care Implementation Specialist serves as a key liaison between Moda Health and partners at rural hospital\-based primary care clinics on Alaska’s Kenai Peninsula. This role provides technical assistance, subject matter expertise, and project management oversight to advance value\-based payment (VBP) readiness through the National Committee on Quality Assurance (NCQA) Primary Care Medical Home (PCMH) implementation. The position partners with hospital and clinic stakeholders to implement a robust quality improvement and data reporting infrastructure to enable quality measure reporting, support population health management, and prepare clinics for sustainable VBP participation through the NCQA PCMH model.



This is a full\-time position. The ideal candidate will reside in Alaska’s Anchorage/Kenai Peninsula region. *This is a limited duration position contingent on continued receipt of RHTP grant funds.*

  


**Pay Range**



$85,000 \- $87,318\.58 annually (depending on experience)  

Actual pay is based on qualifications. Applicants who do not exceed the minimum qualifications will only be eligible for the low end of the pay range.

  

**Please fill out an application on our company page, linked below, to be considered for this position.**



https://j.brt.mv/jb.do?reqGK\=27785428\&refresh\=true  

  

**Benefits****:**


* Medical, Dental, Vision \& Pharmacy
* PTO and Company Paid Holidays
* 401k \- Matching

  

  

**Required Skills, Experience \& Education:**



* Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree in Public Health, Public Policy, or Healthcare Administration\-related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.


* 3 \- 5 years of experience working in healthcare, public health, or health\-related community\-based organizations. Experience working in or with rural or underserved communities preferred.


* Familiarity with NCQA PCMH and/or Oregon’s Patient\-Centered Primary Care Home requirements and recognition processes.


* Demonstrated understanding of value\-based payment (VBP) systems and APMs in healthcare settings.


* Knowledge of primary care clinic functions such as case management/care coordination, use of electronic health record (EHR) systems, population health\-level metrics and reporting, behavioral health integration, and collaboration with Traditional Health Workers (THWs).


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially MS Excel and other reporting software.


* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience convening diverse stakeholders and facilitating productive virtual and in\-person meetings.


* Ability to manage complex projects, track activities, and meet short and long\-term project milestones.


* Ability to maintain confidentiality and project a professional business image.
  


**Primary Functions****:**



* Serve as subject matter expert to partner hospital organization leadership on all matters related to PCMH recognition and Alternative Payment Model (APM) design and implementation.


* Regularly meet with steering committee composed of executive leadership from both Alaska hospitals, Moda Health subject matter experts, and statewide policy partners to guide PCMH implementation, resolve barriers, and ensure shared ownership of key decisions.


* Use project management skills to create and maintain detailed implementation plan and task trackers across multiple stakeholder organizations.


* Provide technical assistance to partner organizations, enabling achievement of core and elective criteria for PCMH recognition across the concepts of team\-based care and practice organization, knowing and managing patients, patient\-centered access, care management and support, care coordination and transitions, performance measurement and quality improvement, and behavioral health integration.


* Partner closely with Medicaid Quality and Innovation Manager, Grants Management Specialist, and Medicaid Quality Supervisor to support clinical partners in meeting RHTP requirements and timeline.


* Use independent judgment to make key business decisions and provide informed recommendations on PCMH criteria implementation and APM design to partner organizations and Moda Health senior leadership.


* Perform other duties as assigned.
  



Working Conditions \& Contact with Others:


* Office environment with extensive close PC and keyboard use, constant sitting, and frequent phone communication. Must be able to navigate multiple computer screens. A reliable, high\-speed, hard\-wired internet connection required to support remote or hybrid work. Must be comfortable being on camera for virtual training and meetings. Work in excess of standard workweek, including evenings and occasional weekends, to meet business need. Occasional and overnight travel may be required.
* Internally with all Moda departments. Externally with partner healthcare organizations and vendors.

  


**Together, we can be more. We can be better.**

This is applicable to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absences, compensation, and training.
